name: metrifi

interface.shortDescription: One MetriFi sign-in to the MetriFi platform (Site Builder, GEO AI-search visibility, and CRO analytics) plus the MetriFi site-design skills. No token paste.

description: The MetriFi plugin: one MetriFi sign-in to the MetriFi platform (Site Builder, GEO AI-search visibility, and CRO analytics) plus the MetriFi skills — client-report for auditing an institution's existing site, generate-claude-design-system, generate-claude-design-page and page-design-process for designing and building one, and personalization for building and measuring behavioural personalization. Self-contained: no other plugins needed. Analyze, design, personalize and edit conversion-optimized credit-union and bank websites the MetriFi way.
